scope: Exactly the 37 assigned GCP IDs; bound predicates, closure values, reachable helpers, native collectors and current official API contracts were reviewed individually.

instance.assessment: Instances expose serviceAccounts, scheduling, canIpForward, deletionProtection, shieldedInstanceConfig, confidentialInstanceConfig, disks, metadata and networkInterfaces configuration.

host.assessment: automaticRestart and onHostMaintenance are distinct scheduling fields; some machine types cannot live migrate and require an owner exception.

disk.assessment: diskEncryptionKey.sha256 is an output digest for the historical CSEK mode; the current API reference marks CSEK fields deprecated and recommends CMEK.

firewall.assessment: Ingress ALLOW entries use IPProtocol and ports separately from DENY entries; source ranges/selectors, disabled and direction govern declared applicability.

network.assessment: IPv4Range is the historical legacy-network field; autoCreateSubnetworks chooses auto versus custom VPC subnet creation and is a separate property.

legacy.assessment: Creation through IPv4Range is deprecated/unavailable; historical detection does not authorize creating a legacy network.

dns.assessment: networks.networkUrl binds DNS policies to networks and enableLogging controls the logging declaration.

oslogin.assessment: Instance enable-oslogin takes precedence over project metadata; OS Login with 2FA requires both enable-oslogin and enable-oslogin-2fa true.

project.assessment: Compute projects.get independently supplies commonInstanceMetadata and fingerprint; Resource Manager project identity is not metadata configuration.

orgpolicy.assessment: Effective policy is returned for the named project and constraint after hierarchy evaluation.

ssl.assessment: minTlsVersion includes TLS_1_3, which requires RESTRICTED profile. SSL profile and minimum version are separate policy properties.

proxy.assessment: sslPolicy references an SSL policy on the target HTTPS proxy; absence leaves no explicit policy attached.

urlmap.assessment: Backend service references may be full or partial URLs; routing can use defaultService, path rules and weightedBackendServices rather than only the default backend.

backend.assessment: BackendService.logConfig.enable declares request logging; it is not evidence that requests reached an endpoint or logs were retained.

gke.assessment: Cluster responses include nodePools, networkConfig and ipAllocationPolicy; node-pool configuration can differ from cluster defaults.

pool.assessment: NodePool.config and management are pool-specific settings.

management.assessment: autoRepair and autoUpgrade are separate boolean flags within the returned management message.

nodeconfig.assessment: NodeConfig.imageType and metadata are native pool configuration; metadata map values are strings interpreted by the node image.

shielded.assessment: Node-pool integrity monitoring defaults on and secure boot defaults off; the features are independently configurable.

subnet.assessment: Subnetwork logConfig and legacy enableFlowLogs describe subnet logging; subnet purpose determines whether the setting is supported.

flow.assessment: Network Management configs can target a network/subnet, carry a filterExpr, and have ENABLED/DISABLED state; STATE_UNSPECIFIED defaults to ENABLED.

validation.network_guard: Autouse fixture blocks socket.create_connection, socket.socket.connect, socket.getaddrinfo and GCP Credentials; every fake resolver asserts GET plus exact URL allowlist, including host/path.
validation.input_mutation_guard: Each evaluate_snapshot call deep-compares its snapshot before/after.
validation.partial_inventory_semantics: A returned resource can retain its local verdict alongside an UNKNOWN finding for uncollected remainder; dependency absence/joins need complete evidence.
validation.singleton_limit: Project metadata GET does not paginate; its generic partial matrix cell verifies the singleton read rather than claiming a pagination failure was exercised.
fixture_corrections: Intra-node visibility omission uses the documented false default rather than UNKNOWN.
CSEK and Flow Logs malformed fixtures now target sha256 and logConfig.enable themselves; an arbitrary extra parent property is not the selected malformed scalar.

The base fixture transport omitted the scope field carried by the real request ledger. NativeTransport now copies the actual request scope into evidence, so numeric project alias proof passes without injecting compliance or alias attestations.
No diskless/scratch-only VM or incompatible vTPM-disabled/monitoring-enabled positive fixture is used.

upstream.mapping_counterexample: A nonlegacy custom VPC with autoCreateSubnetworks=false correctly passes the native no-legacy predicate but alarms in the mapped upstream auto-create-subnetwork query. This is lineage non-equivalence, not missing automation or an authorization to enforce automatic subnet creation.
